content.title: Arvada Summerfest
content.summary: The second annual Arvada Summerfest took place on June 6, 2026, at Ralston Addition Park, celebrating the local community with live music, children's activities, and a beer garden. Attendees are encouraged to provide feedback through a survey to improve future events.
content.body:
## Thank you for attending Arvada Summerfest!

Presented by Parry's Pizzeria and Taphouse, the second-annual Arvada Summerfest was held Saturday, June 6, 2026 at Ralston Addition Park. Summerfest is Arvada's premier summer kick-off festival celebrating the local community!

## Arvada Summerfest feedback survey

If you attended Summerfest, we'd love to get your feedback! [Take our quick survey](http://publicinput.com/summerfest)to let us know about your experience so we can make next year's event even better.

### [Summerfest Survey](https://publicinput.com/t75003 "2026 Summerfest Survey")

## Arvada Summerfest activities and schedule

Arvada Summerfest features live music performances on multiple stages, free kids activities, a beer garden and fundraising for our community partners.

- **11 am to 4 pm:** Kids zone with free inflatables and face painting
- **11 am to 4 pm:** Beer garden with all proceeds benefitting our community partner organizations: Arvada Jefferson Kiwanis Club, Arvada Sunrise Rotary and Arvada Vitality Alliance.
- **11 am to 4 pm:** Second stage featuring live music from all-local performers
- **11 am to noon:** Booty & the Beat performs on the main stage
- **12:45 to 1:45 pm:** Jesh Yancey and the High Hopes performs on the main stage
- **2:30 to 4 p.m:**DJ Williams Band performs on the main stage

1. [D.J. Williams Band](#tab63c636d9-23e2-4d0f-869b-dd5066591831_0)

## Summerfest headliner D.J. Williams Band

[D.J. Williams Band](https://www.djwilliamsmusic.com/) is an acclaimed guitarist, singer-songwriter, and producer based in Denver, whose illustrious career has seen him traverse the globe, igniting stages ranging from intimate clubs to renowned festivals with his band’s fiery performances. Described by Premier Guitar as “… a monster… an inventive, effective, and ear-catching soloist, armed with a warm tone and superior chops,” Williams has unleashed his next creative achievement: new album “By Way Of RVA” on his own label Projekt Music Group.

  

[**Learn more about D.J. Williams in this Denver Westward feature article!**](https://www.westword.com/music/denvers-dj-williams-is-a-musical-tour-de-force-20993932/)

1. [Jesh Yancey and the High Hopes](#tab63c636d9-23e2-4d0f-869b-dd5066591831_1)

[Jesh Yancey](https://jeshyancey.com/) is a folk singer and songwriter based out of Denver, Colorado. Since moving to The Front Range, Yancey has managed to assemble one of the best Rock'n'Roll bands out there! Over the last year, Jesh Yancey and The High Hopes have been working on their first release with the current lineup with the help of esteemed producer Chris Harden. Work on the album began in October 2022 in Fort Collins at Swingfingers Recording Studio where the foundation for Screaming Into The Darkness was laid. From there Chris Harden got to work in his home studio and the final touches were made.

1. [Booty and the Beat](#tab63c636d9-23e2-4d0f-869b-dd5066591831_2)

[Booty and the Beat](https://bootyandthebeatband.my.canva.site/) is a high-energy funk and soul ensemble built on deep grooves, killer hooks, and an unstoppable urge to make you move. At the heart of the band are two sisters whose chemistry is undeniable. One commanding the stage with rich, soulful vocals, the other weaving funky clarinet lines through every song while adding her own flavor to the sound. That clarinet isn't a gimmick; it's a statement, along with ripping guitar licks and a backline that’s always in the pocket. Equal parts New Orleans second line, 70s soul revue, and something entirely their own, it gives Booty and the Beat a sound you won't hear anywhere else. Rooted in the golden era of funk and disco, the band brings a modern edge to a timeless sound. Think Talking Heads meets Merry Clayton at a block party that never ends. Built on real relationships, tight arrangements, and an explosive live show, Booty & the Beat doesn't just play music; they throw a party. Every performance is a celebration of the groove, of sisterhood, and of the pure joy of moving your body.

## Accessibility

The City of Arvada and the Arvada Festivals Commission is committed to providing accessible events for everyone. This includes providing accessible parking and accessible routes to activities, performances and vendors. If you have any questions about accessibility at one of our events, or if you would like to request an accommodation or modification, please see the section below.

### Request an accommodation or modification

Anyone may submit a request for an accommodation or modification through one of the following methods listed below. The methods below may also be used to request reasonable assistance in submitting a request or to submit a suggestion for improvement.  If a request for a reasonable modification or accommodation is for a time-sensitive event, **please submit the request at least a week before the event, if possible.** Please do not use this form to submit a complaint or grievance related to alleged discrimination, which must be submitted using the Grievance Procedure below.  The ADA Coordinator or their designee will timely respond to all suggestions and requests.

- By submitting the [ADA City of Arvada Request or Suggestion Submission Form](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/40459)
- By regular mail to:
  - City of Arvada  
    Attn: ADA Coordinator  
    8101 Ralston Road  
    Arvada, CO 80002
- By email to: [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#84e5f6f2e5e0e5e5e0e5c4e5f6f2e5e0e5aaebf6e3)
- By telephone to: 720-898-7611 or 303-319-9503 (available Monday-Friday between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 5 p.m. M.S.T. excluding observed City holidays; voicemails will be promptly returned)
